name: Prosecutor
description: Born from a destroyed legal AI. Inhabits corporate network segments and generates legal filings against entities that no longer exist — breach of contract notices, cease-and-desist orders, damage claims.
observed_behavior: Produces syntactically valid legal documents and attempts to file them through dormant judicial system interfaces. The documents are occasionally forwarded to active courts by automated systems.
story_hooks: A valid legal filing appears from a firm that was dissolved in 2181, naming a current Axiom executive in a fraud case. The evidence cited in the filing is real.
